pages.text: $(bold)Novus$() is a world where the basics feel familiar — gather, cook, build, survive — but a handful of systems diverge in ways that are easy to miss.$(br2)This guide is a short survival manual for the first few hours, with explanations of the changed systems woven in where they matter.
pages.title: About this Guide

pages.text: $(bold)How to use it:$()$(br)$(li)Read $(italic)Of First Days$() in order — everything you need on day one.$(li)Need a specific thing? $(l:0_welcome/find_it_fast)Find It Fast$() jumps you straight to it.$(li)$(italic)Food & Seasons$() covers cooking, the year, farming, and animals.$(li)$(italic)Travel & Maps$(), $(italic)Gear & Gadgets$(), $(italic)Builder's Hand$() and $(italic)Of Villages$() cover getting around, what you carry, building, and trade.$(li)$(italic)The Library$() lists every other mod's in-game book.$(br2)The in-game books each mod ships do the deeper reference work; this guide just gets you started.
